name: IC 1, long run to t = 400
setup: IC 1 run to t = 400 (paper Fig. 4), five times longer than any training trajectory (T_train = 80), with the larger time step dT = 0.05.
expect: Errors accumulate over long runs, so this tests stability, not just accuracy. Expect the reduced models to stay close but drift a bit more than at t = 200.
observed: Still accurate after 400 time units: q error 0.39% with MCL-NN. No blow-up, no growing oscillations. Takes about 40 s because the DNS has 80,000 steps.
